_notes: DJI Matrice 30T thermal camera, 640x512 radiometric frames, as in the FLAME 3 CV subset (Sycan Marsh).
Intrinsics MEASURED from 54 FLAME 3 frames (experiments/flame3/measure_thermal_fov.py): each Celsius TIFF
was registered to its raw wide-camera RGB. Pixels are square (fx/fy = 0.997); fx agrees with DJI's 61 deg
diagonal FOV (696 px), not with 9.1 mm / 12 um (758 px). Frame-to-frame spread +-5 px (fx), +-2 px (cx, cy).
The values are relative to the wide camera's focal length (2775 px, from DJI's 84 deg DFOV and the 24 mm
equivalent), so they carry its ~1% uncertainty. Not checkerboard-calibrated; no distortion model.
cx, cy is the thermal pixel along the wide camera's axis, i.e. along the gimbal angles: the thermal
camera points ~1.1 deg left and ~0.8 deg up of the wide camera. The FLAME 3 'Corrected FOV' RGB crop
(x=620, y=454, 2628x2032 in the raw frame, the same in every frame) is ~3% too wide; do not use it for geometry.
Pose is NOT in the thermal files: read it from the paired raw RGB (--exif_image_dir <class>/RGB/Raw).
GimbalYawDegree is absolute (tracks FlightYawDegree within a few degrees). True vs magnetic north is unverified.
altitude_reference 'takeoff': RelativeAltitude is height above the take-off point. The laser_* fields are
used only with --altitude_source laser (height above the laser rangefinder's ground point).
name: DJI M30T thermal (FLAME 3)
